event.description:
Grand Archive Regionals - Phantom Monarch Season
EDIT: IF YOU HAVE SIGNED UP BUT NOT YET PURCHASED A TICKET, PLEASE HEAD TO THE HERETICS HAVEN WEBSITE AND PURCHASE A TICKET ASAP. WE ARE ALMOST TO OUR INSTORE CAPACITY, SO TO ENSURE A PLACE PLEASE MAKE SURE TO GRAB A TICKET. WE WILL HOLD TICKETS OPEN UNTIL SATURDAY NIGHT. - THANK YOU HERETICS TEAM
Join us at Heretics Have on Sunday the 15th March from 9.30am for our first even Grand Archive Regionals Event.

This event will be Standard Constructed Format and Ticket Entry will be $30 per person. Tickets will be available on the Heretics Haven TCG website ⁦https://tcg.hereticshaven.com.au⁩  (The Tickets will go Live closer to the event date and will be updated here.)

Doors will open 9.30am for Check in, for a 10.00am Start. Rounds will be 60 mins each with a Best of 3 format. 

Dependent on amount of players signed up we will have either a Cut to TOP 4 or TOP 8 Single Elimination Rounds, this event will be capped at 48 Players. 

Decklists will be required to be submitted through the Omnidex event system, and will not be accepted physically on the day, so please make sure you have these submitted in time!

For Prizing, each player will receive 2 Qty Booster Packs of Phantom Monarch Boosters for attendance. Additionally, Up for grabs will be Phantom Monarchs Event Packs, the new Regionals Binder, as well as the new Phantom Monarchs Sapphire Pack!

Come join us for what’s sure to be an amazing day!
event.name: Heretics Haven - Grand Archive Regionals - Phantom Monarch Season
